decisions.state_note: o000: Window near x53–116,y151–214 shows a bright textured region with a curved lower edge and narrow bright ridge near (83,202), dark pixels below. Could be footwear; full shape unknown.

Dark pixels lie to the left; detector reports local bright-right transitions near (176,60) and (166,79). Bag or footwear remains uncertain.

o012: Window x149–212,y119–182 shows a pale curved band at upper left and a narrow bright upright strip near x193–208, with dark pixels between. Detector reports opposing vertical transitions near x192 and x207. Footwear remains a hypothesis; lower structure is unseen.

o014: Window x117–180,y151–214 is mostly dark, with a pale diagonal fragment at upper left. Detector reports local transitions near x121; this does not establish a complete contour. Earlier narrow upright right-side material and diagonal band suggest heeled footwear, with sandal a hypothesis.

o015: Window x85–148,y151–214 shows pale textured material at left and a curved bright band rising toward the upper right, with dark pixels below and right. No detector instances. Heeled sandal remains a hypothesis; moving left to inspect the front.

o016: Window near x53–116,y151–214 shows broad pale textured material, a bright band near y162, and a curved lower ridge near (83,202) with dark pixels below, supported by the detector. Earlier thin bands and narrow right upright suggest a heeled sandal; inspecting above the front may clarify.

o017: Window near x53–116,y119–182 shows dark pixels above pale layered horizontal material near y155–182; no detections. Together with earlier thin diagonal bands and narrow upright heel-like material at the right, the evidence supports sandal.
